title: New India Assurance – Head Office
excerpt: A-Frame Digital Standees and Wall-Mounted Digital Screens transformed a heritage insurance HQ into a modern, branded environment.
content:
To enhance internal branding, streamline communication, and modernize the digital presence within New India Assurance's head office environment.

New India Assurance, one of India's leading public sector general insurance companies, sought to elevate the digital infrastructure within its Mumbai headquarters.

Through this installation, NIA has taken a significant step toward embracing digital transformation within its physical spaces.

title: Cosmos × IMTEX 2025
summary: L-shaped anamorphic LED screen brought engineering to life in 3D.
excerpt: L-shaped anamorphic LED screen brought precision engineering to life in stunning 3D at India's largest machine tools exhibition.
content:
At India's premier manufacturing exhibition, IMTEX 2025, we deployed a custom-designed L-shaped anamorphic LED screen that brought engineering to life in three dimensions.

The immersive visuals were designed to spotlight Cosmos's four newly launched machines, blending high-impact content with illusion-based creativity.

The result? A nonstop crowd, hundreds of phones recording, and a perfect harmony of technology and storytelling.

title: Ajanta Pharma × Yashobhoomi
summary: Immersive 3D illusion campaign turning heads at a pharma summit.
excerpt: Immersive 3D illusion campaign turning heads and capturing premium mindshare at a national pharma summit in Delhi.
content:
For pharmaceutical giant Ajanta Pharma, innovation isn't limited to the lab — it extends to how they communicate their story.

At a high-profile event held at Yashobhoomi, Delhi, we conceptualized and delivered an anamorphic video experience that turned heads and sparked conversations.

It was a seamless blend of science, design, and digital magic.

title: NBC Bearings × Multi-Vehicle Showcase
summary: Cross-industry 3D narrative showcasing bearings in motion.
excerpt: Cross-industry 3D narrative showcasing ball bearings in motion across automotive, industrial, and rail applications.
content:
NBC Bearings approached us with a unique challenge: showcase the versatility of their products across multiple industries — all in one visual experience.

We responded with a custom anamorphic video that placed NBC's bearings at the heart of motion across cars, bikes, trucks, and more.

The visual narrative peeled back the layers of each vehicle to reveal the bearings in action.

title: Bank of India × Tata Marathon
summary: Emotive corporate film captured during India's biggest marathon.
excerpt: Emotive corporate film captured during India's biggest marathon — showcasing the bank's commitment to community and endurance.
content:
At the Tata Mumbai Marathon 2025, we captured a powerful corporate film that followed BOI employees as they ran for health, unity, and brand spirit.

The result was more than just a shoot — it was a moving, motivational story of resilience and corporate pride.

Every frame was a statement: that real brands are built by real people who go the extra mile.

title: Agrasen × Detroit Airport
summary: U.S. airport DOOH placements for global visibility.
excerpt: Strategic DOOH placements at Detroit Airport delivered global brand visibility to a diaspora audience at peak travel moments.
content:
When Agrasen set its sights on strengthening global visibility, we deployed digital screen placements at Detroit Airport — one of the largest international hubs in the U.S.

The campaign was laser-focused and culturally contextual, connecting Agrasen's global ambitions to a highly relevant, high-footfall location.

title: Solution One ERP × Pin-Code Targeting
summary: Precision media in Pune's Bhosari industrial belt.
excerpt: Precision hyperlocal media in Pune's Bhosari industrial belt — delivering software messaging to decision-makers at their workplace.
content:
When Pune-based ERP company Solution One needed to deepen its footprint in the Bhosari industrial area, we provided a pin-code targeted media solution.

This data-driven approach ensured that every placement spoke to the right audience — decision-makers, factory owners, and tech partners within a precise geographic belt.
